header:
Awesome AI Coding Agents

> Open-source coding agents, editor extensions, CLI tools, review bots and developer workflows built around AI. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Review every change.** Agents make plausible mistakes.
- **Run agents in a branch or sandbox,** not on production.
- **Do not paste secrets** into prompts.
- **Check where code is sent.** Local models keep it on your machine, hosted ones do not.

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
